intro.h2: Cabinets built by the people you talk to
paragraphs: Custom Cabinet & Mill Work builds custom cabinets in Redding, California. It is a small family-run business, so you deal directly with the people who bid, build and install your cabinets.

Customers mention Glen and Chris by name. Steve R. had the shop build custom cabinets for his kitchen. Glen got back to him quickly with a bid and offered to build the bases fast so his granite could go in on time. Chris did the installation and kept checking that Steve was happy with the fit and look. Another customer says the new cabinets were a great match to what they already had.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Every kitchen is built for its room. The kitchen shown here has white shaker cabinets, a peninsula with seating, space framed for a microwave above the range and a tall opening for a French door refrigerator, all made to fit the layout of the house.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen cabinets around a gas range, microwave and French door refrigerator

items.name: Matching the cabinets you have
items.blurb: Adding on or replacing a few pieces? One customer had cabinets built piece by piece to match what was already in the house and called it a great match. Matching door styles and finishes is what keeps an addition from looking added on.

image.alt: Raised panel cabinet door on a workbench next to unfinished wood, with a pencil for marking

items.name: Cabinet installation
items.blurb: Chris installs the cabinets the shop builds. Steve R. says Chris was always checking in with him to make sure he was satisfied with the fit and look of the cabinets, so problems are caught while the installer is still in your kitchen.

image.alt: Run of white shaker drawers and cabinets with dark countertop and stainless dishwasher on a wood floor

items.name: Working with your countertop schedule
items.blurb: Countertops can't be templated until the base cabinets are in. When Steve R. had a granite installation waiting, Glen offered to quickly build the bases first so the granite could go in. Tell Glen about your schedule when you ask for a bid.

image.alt: Kitchen peninsula with dark countertop, white base cabinets and bar stools

about.text: Custom Cabinet & Mill Work is a cabinet maker at 1610 Tahoe Ct in Redding, California. Customers describe it as a small family-run business. Glen is the name you will hear most: he puts together the bids and builds the cabinets, and one reviewer sums it up simply as, Glen does amazing work. Chris handles installation and checks in with you to make sure the fit and look are right. The shop builds kitchen cabinets to fit your room and can build new pieces to match cabinets you already have. Every review on Google gives five stars.
about.owner_role: Named in reviews as the person who bids and builds the cabinets; owner title and last name not confirmed. Chris installs.

service_area.text: Custom Cabinet & Mill Work is based at 1610 Tahoe Ct in Redding, California, and builds and installs cabinets for local homeowners. The Google listing does not name other towns or a service area. If you live outside Redding and want to know whether the shop can take on your kitchen, call (530) 246-7450 and ask Glen before you plan the rest of your project.

items.q: Can you match the cabinets I already have?
items.a: Yes. One customer had new cabinets built piece by piece to match what was already in the home and called it a great match. If you are adding on or replacing part of a kitchen, tell Glen what you have now, and photos of your doors and finish will help.

items.q: Do you install the cabinets too?
items.a: Yes. Chris handles installation. Steve R. says Chris was always checking in with him to make sure he was satisfied with the fit and look of the cabinets, and that he would definitely use the shop again for his next project.

items.q: My countertops are scheduled. Can you work around that?
items.a: Ask about it when you call. When one customer had granite waiting to be installed, Glen offered to quickly build the base cabinets first so the countertop work could go ahead. Let Glen know your countertop dates when you ask for a bid so he can plan the order of the work.

items.q: How do I get a bid?
items.a: Call (530) 246-7450 and describe your kitchen or the pieces you need. Customers say Glen gets back quickly with a bid. No prices are listed on this page because every set of cabinets is built for a different room and a different list of needs.

items.q: Where are you, and when are you open?
items.a: The shop is at 1610 Tahoe Ct, Redding, CA 96003. Business hours are not listed on Google, so please call (530) 246-7450 before stopping by, to make sure Glen or Chris is there and available to talk through your project.
